name: AutoShot
original_description: AutoShot helps car dealers and vehicle sellers prepare consistent photos for vehicle listings. Choose a studio background, apply your saved dealership logo to exterior photos, and select license-plate treatment. Preview all five backgrounds, process photos in batches, and download each result from one card. Save background and plate preferences for future photos and retrieve recent results. Manage logo uploads in your AutoShot account. Interior photos retain their cabin view and receive no dealership-logo stamp. Review generated photos before publishing.

limitations_ja: 車内写真には販売店ロゴを入れず車内の表示を維持すると説明。公開前に結果を確認するよう求めている。
